name: Ballee: The Sandbox
summary: Ballee is a very experimental sandbox that brings any real-world ball into your mixed reality space. It is not a polished or finished product, but an open playground where many things are still unstable, unpredictable, and constantly evolving. That is part of the fun, because it invites you to try out what works and to discover completely new ways of playing.
